archetype: The Performance Pro / Swiss High-Contrast Precision
instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor Map 360 geospatial application according to user feedback: 1) Display all addresses as individual points/pins directly upon load without circle clustering by default, auto-framing bounds so all points are visible at once. 2) Implement a clear Basemap switcher between 'Mapa claro' (Light vector/OSM) and 'Satélite' (Esri World Imagery raster) with label overlay options. 3) Add an authenticated 'Aquí vivo yo' / 'Confirmar que [Persona] vive aquí' confirmation action on selected person/household locations that updates verification status and displays a verified badge. 4) Clean up zone and subzone labels so letters and numbers are discrete, zoom-aware, and non-obtrusive, avoiding map visual noise. 5) Preserve all existing Map 360 capabilities: filters, search, sector polygon editor, review queue, unlocated drawer, evangelism minicenso, 2to1 presentation mode, comparison band, and strict RBAC capabilities.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Avoid generic centered layouts, default blue/purple gradients, and dense crowded toolbars. Use crisp, high-contrast Swiss typography, generous functional padding, layered z-index hierarchy, and purpose-built geospatial control bars.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.hover_active_contrast: Ensure text remains 100% legible against high-contrast backgrounds during hover, focus, and active states. Always explicitly specify text colors on hover (e.g. hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.header_overlays: DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for headers, floating map toolbars, or detail panels. Use heavy backdrop blur glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90 or bg-slate-950/90) with subtle borders (border-slate-200/80 or border-slate-800/80).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, map controls, popups, badges, and modals MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format (e.g., data-testid='basemap-toggle-satellite', data-testid='confirm-person-location-button', data-testid='geo-household-pin-123').

colors.theme_mode: Light Dashboard with Dark Obsidian & Satin Slate Accents

geospatial_map_specifications.clustering_behavior: Disabled by default for precise household and person view. Mode defaults to 'pins' (puntos individuales), rendering every address as an individual custom canvas pin with resident counts.
geospatial_map_specifications.auto_fit_bounds: Upon initial load or filter/kind update, compute the bounding box of all loaded feature coordinates and trigger map.fitBounds(bounds, { padding: 60, maxZoom: 16 }) so all address points are framed at once.

zone_label_rules.opacity: Zone fills rendered at opacity 0.08 - 0.12. Zone outlines set to thin 1.5px line.
zone_label_rules.label_zoom_awareness: Zone labels ('Zona 1 · Norte', etc.) and subzone letters ('1-A', '2-B') use zoom thresholds. Below zoom 11, show clean discrete badges with maxzoom/minzoom rules so text does not obstruct address pins. At high zoom (>14), fade out zone fill/labels completely to spotlight street detail.

modes.label: Satélite
modes.attribution: Tiles © Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics, USDA, USGS, AeroGRID, IGN, GIS Community

basemap_switcher.control_ui: Floating or toolbar segment with icon buttons 'Mapa Claro' (Map icon) and 'Satélite' (Globe/Satellite icon) in GeoMapToolbar and on-map floating toggle control.

confirm_person_location.trigger_action: Button 'Aquí vivo yo' / 'Confirmar esta ubicación' inside GeoDetailPanel, GeoPersonSearch popup, and Person Profile Geo card.
confirm_person_location.api_flow: Calls POST /api/geo/review-queue/{review_id}/resolve or PUT /api/person_addresses/{id} with manual_verified status.
confirm_person_location.visual_feedback: Instant toast via Sonner 'Ubicación confirmada para [Persona]', updates pin indicator to show green verified checkmark badge, and logs audit record.

layouts.toolbar: Streamlined single-line GeoMapToolbar with clear visual hierarchy: Title/Icon -> Kind Tabs (Personas / Células / Casas) -> Basemap Selector (Mapa Claro / Satélite) -> Mode Selector (Puntos / Densidad / Clusters) -> Persona Search -> Filters & Action Buttons.
layouts.map_workspace: Full-bleed relative flex-1 container with absolute floating controls, detail panel drawer, search dropdown overlay, and comparison band.
layouts.detail_panel: Floating right-aligned drawer (md:right-4 md:top-4 md:w-80) with frosted glass header, address details, category tags, 'Aquí vivo yo' confirmation CTA, and links to 360 profile.

grids.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid for Geo Analytics sidebar and statistics modals.
grids.filters_grid: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3 p-4

motion.map_camera: map.flyTo and map.fitBounds with duration 800ms and ease-in-out easing.
motion.panel_entrance: transition-all duration-200 ease-out transform translate-y-0 opacity-100

accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full tab index and ARIA labels on all toolbar buttons, layer toggles, and search inputs.
accessibility.contrast_ratio: APCA high contrast for text badges on satellite basemaps. Text overlays on satellite tiles use translucent dark scrims (bg-slate-950/80 text-white).
accessibility.screen_readers: All map markers have aria-label describing entity kind and resident/member count.

3d_libraries.usage: 2.5D raster and vector tile rendering, 3D pitch/bearing controls when exploring terrain or satellite basemaps.

key_functionalities: Mapa 360 territorial existente con personas, hogares, células, zonas, subzonas, sectores y casas por visitar
Todos los hogares/direcciones precisos visibles como puntos individuales sin clustering por defecto (modo 'pins')
Autoencuadre automático de todos los puntos al cargar y filtrar
Selector de basemap Mapa claro vs. Satélite en la barra superior y mapa
Capas de zona y sector discretas con etiquetas zoom-aware para evitar ruido visual
Búsqueda/selección de persona con acción autenticada 'Aquí vivo yo' / 'Confirmar que aquí vive esta persona'
Filtros, búsqueda, sectores, presentación 2-a-1 y RBAC preservados e intactos
